stem: Veronica would like to add a topic sentence to her seventh paragraph (sentences 27–31). Which of the following sentences should be added before sentence 27 to accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: Nyakarundi also sees his idea as a form of aid for his community.

options.label: B
options.text: Nyakarundi loves the challenges of running his own business.

options.label: C
options.text: Wanting people to enjoy their work is Nyakarundi’s mission.

options.label: D
options.text: Most people are grateful for Nyakarundi’s help.
